scope: Exact selected-frame canonical pixel-key index; not transformed/local-feature index
key_semantics: Canonical linear-sRGB RGBA32 with dimensions, invisible RGB ignored and signed-zero canonicalized
Sample scale IEEE bits and optional cursor hotspot included
Container frame count/index excluded, same selected-frame semantics as direct comparison
BLAKE3 key is only a candidate filter; every same-key pair is directly confirmed
qualified: Exhaustive equality equivalence on six fixtures
Injected complete hash collision never admits unequal pixels
Scale/hotspot key separation and container selection exclusion
Mutation after own decode and before source decode invalidates stale decisions
Final generation/transient callback cancellation returns no report
Recursive overlap, corrupt-file and missing-source diagnostics
Candidate-pair admission and memory reservations release

validation.clippy: passed all features tests/examples no-deps -D warnings

limitations: Same-key groups can still require quadratic result/confirmation counts
No measured large-image throughput or physical memory proof
Not an index for crop/rotation/photometric similarity
Selected frame only; not whole-animation/container equality
